name: vibebox
description: Universal local-first memory middleware where AI agents provide structured memory candidates and Core manages them.

interface.shortDescription: Local structured memory for AI coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Use VibeBox's local CLI and shared skill instructions to retrieve active guidance before coding, then capture the original userRequest with rich AI-agent structured memory candidates after work. The agent decomposes reusable success criteria, validation rules, reporting preferences, failure-prevention rules, successful approaches, task context, categories, relations, and localized display text. VibeBox Core does not infer active memory from raw requests or summaries; it validates, stores, indexes, and renders the candidates supplied by the agent.
defaultPrompt: Capture this task with userRequest and rich structured candidates for each reusable meaning unit.
Explain why there is only one candidate, or include no_reusable_memory_candidate with noCandidateReason.
Audit VibeBox memory manually when debugging.
